text:
Live plants ship **Monday to Wednesday only**.

- Plant orders placed after **12 noon on Wednesday** ship the following Monday.
- Non-living items (pots, soil, accessories) ship Monday to Friday. If an order mixes plants and non-living items, everything ships together on a plant shipping day.
- In extreme weather (forecast below 35°F or above 95°F in transit), live plants may be held for up to 7 days, and we'll email you if that happens.

Once your order ships, delivery takes 2-3 business days for Standard shipping in Zone 1, up to 5-8 business days in Zone 3.
